id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data displayed on the navigation

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

collapsible.description: Whether the Side Navigation Panel will be collapsible or not.

collapsed.description: Whether the Side Navigation Panel is collapsed.

resizable.description:
Whether the Collapsible Navigation Panel will be resizable or not.
If the {@link UiSdlCollapsibleNavigation} is used inside {@link UiSdlGridLayout} this field
will automatically be set to `false`.

data.description: Holds the data to display on the navigation

navItems.description:
Used internally to rectify the data specified in the dataSpec, and any downstream changes to data, such as
modifying via derived props

title:
The remix {@link UiSdlCollapsibleNavigation}.
This is necessary to add disabled states and disabled reason tooltips to these navigation menu items.
name: UiSdlCollapsibleNavigationReact
